title: Kamakura shrine and Great Buddha · Enoshima sunset · free Tocho night view · Umi no Ie nomihodai · Golden Gai · karaoke

stops.name: Odakyu Shinjuku: Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass + konbini breakfast
stops.plan: Buy the Odakyu Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass each (ticket machines or the EMot app), grab onigiri and coffee at the konbini, board the next Rapid Express to Fujisawa.
stops.transport: Odakyu line Rapid Express Shinjuku → Fujisawa (about 55 min), Enoden Fujisawa → Kamakura (about 35 min), walk 12 min up Wakamiya-oji; all on the Freepass

stops.name: Tsurugaoka Hachimangu
stops.plan: Kamakura's main shrine: climb the steps to the main hall, already dressed for New Year.

stops.name: Komachi-dori street-food lunch
stops.plan: Graze down Kamakura's snack street in two groups of four: shirasu buns, croquettes, dango, matcha soft serve.
stops.transport: Walk 3 min to Kamakura station, Enoden Kamakura → Hase (about 5 min), walk 8 min

stops.name: Kotoku-in Great Buddha
stops.plan: The giant open-air bronze Daibutsu; pay the small extra to step inside the statue. Hase-dera is next door if anyone splits off for 30 min.
stops.transport: Walk 8 min to Hase, Enoden Hase → Enoshima (about 20 min, coast views), walk 15 min over the bridge; Freepass

stops.name: Enoshima island at sunset
stops.plan: Up through the shrine lanes to the top of the island, then the rocky west side for sunset with Fuji over the sea (about 16:35).
stops.transport: Walk 15 min to Katase-Enoshima, Odakyu Enoshima line to Fujisawa and Rapid Express → Shinjuku (about 70 min on the Freepass return), walk 10 min to the Tocho

stops.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observatory
stops.plan: Free 202 m night view over Shinjuku (both decks open today; the north deck closes tomorrow), then catch a projection-mapping show on the facade on the way out.
stops.transport: Toei Oedo line Tochomae → Shinjuku-nishiguchi (2 min), walk 10 min under the tracks to Kabukicho (about 27 min door to door)

stops.name: Umi no Ie Shinjuku Higashiguchi: unlimited nomihodai dinner
stops.plan: The cheap base: ¥1,480 all-you-can-drink (Hot Pepper coupon) with free-flow gyoza and oden; order 2 dishes each. Book by phone for 8 (one person free).

stops.name: Shinjuku Golden Gai
stops.plan: Split into two groups of four and hop bars that post English prices; skip 'regulars only' doors. Bring cash.

stops.name: Karaokekan Kabukicho Honten
stops.plan: Party room for 8 on the late-night flat rate with the free-flow drinks add-on, until you're done.
stops.price: Late-night flat rate + drinks plan (check karaokekan.jp)
stops.transport: Walk 14 min home to Garfield House
